note: 0110-10-05 C: five synthetic cases for the tailor prompt's before/after eval (run_tailor_cases_eval.py). Every name, company and number is invented.

cases.title: Staff Platform Engineer
cases.posting:
Northgate Systems runs the booking platform behind 2,000 clinics. The platform team owns the Kubernetes clusters every product team deploys to.

What you will do:
- Run and improve our Kubernetes platform on AWS.
- Own the delivery path from merge to production.

Requirements:
- 7+ years operating Kubernetes in production
- Helm charts for packaging and releasing services
- GitOps delivery with ArgoCD
- Terraform for infrastructure as code
- Monitoring with Prometheus and Grafana

Nice to have:
- Go
cases.resume:
## Summary
Platform engineer with 9 years building and running Kubernetes platforms for logistics and payments companies; owned CI/CD and infrastructure as code end to end.

## Experience
**Senior Platform Engineer — Lumen Freight** (2021–Present)
- Led the migration of 40 services from EC2 to Kubernetes on EKS, cutting deploy time from 45 minutes to 6.
- Built Terraform modules for networking and IAM used by 5 product teams.
- Owned the on-call rotation and incident reviews for the platform team of 6 engineers.
- Introduced GitHub Actions pipelines with automated canary analysis for every service.

**Platform Engineer — Brightpay** (2017–2021)
- Operated a multi-tenant Kubernetes cluster serving 120 microservices in production.
- Wrote Python tooling that reduced cloud spend by 18% through rightsizing.
- Built Prometheus and Grafana dashboards and alerts for payment latency.

**Systems Engineer — Corvid Hosting** (2015–2017)
- Automated Linux server provisioning with Ansible for 300 hosts.
- Maintained Nagios monitoring and a Bash-based backup system.

## Skills
- Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, AWS, GitHub Actions
- Python, Go, Bash
- Prometheus, Grafana, Linux

## Education
**B.Sc. Computer Science — Halden University** (2015)

answers.prompt: Do you have hands-on Helm experience?
answers.answer: Yes. At Lumen Freight I packaged and released our services with Helm charts for the last 3 years.
No, I have not used ArgoCD; our delivery runs on GitHub Actions.

cases.title: Senior Backend Engineer
cases.posting:
Fennel Logistics moves 3 million parcels a week for online retailers. The backend team builds the services that route and track every parcel.

Requirements:
- 8+ years building backend services in Python or Go
- PostgreSQL at scale
- Event streaming with Kafka
- Experience leading a small team

Nice to have:
- Airflow
cases.resume:
## Summary
Backend engineer with 18 years building high-throughput services in Python, Go and PostgreSQL for logistics, banking, media and health companies; led teams of up to 5 and owned services end to end.

## Experience
**Staff Backend Engineer — Meridian Parcel** (2022–Present)
- Led the redesign of the parcel tracking service in Python and PostgreSQL, raising throughput from 2,000 to 11,000 events per second while keeping p99 latency under 80 ms.
- Owned the Kafka ingestion pipeline end to end, including schema evolution, replay tooling and the runbooks used by 4 on-call engineers.
- Architected the move from a shared database to per-service schemas, removing 37 cross-service joins and cutting incident count by 40%.
- Built the rate limiting and quota service used by 60 partner integrations, with per-tenant dashboards and alerts.
- Mentored 5 engineers through design reviews and pairing, two of whom were promoted to senior within 18 months.
- Introduced contract tests between 14 services, catching breaking API changes before release in the CI pipeline.
- Designed the idempotent event replay tool that reprocessed 90 million tracking events after a carrier outage without a single duplicate delivery notice.
- Owned the service level objectives for 8 backend services and ran the weekly reliability review with product and support leads.
- Built the address normalisation service in Go, raising first-attempt delivery rates by 6% across 3 countries.
- Led the PostgreSQL major version upgrade for 11 databases with under 4 minutes of total write downtime.

**Senior Backend Engineer — Tallow Bank** (2019–2022)
- Built the ledger reconciliation service in Python, matching 3 million card transactions a day against the core banking system with a 99.98% match rate.
- Designed the PostgreSQL partitioning scheme for the transactions tables, reducing the nightly batch window from 5 hours to 50 minutes.
- Led a team of 4 engineers delivering the instant payments integration, shipped 3 weeks ahead of the regulatory deadline.
- Owned the fraud scoring API, serving 900 requests per second with a p95 latency of 35 ms in production.
- Wrote the migration tooling that moved 220 batch jobs from cron to Airflow with no missed runs.
- Ran the quarterly disaster recovery exercises for the payments domain across 2 regions.
- Designed the double-entry bookkeeping library adopted by 7 services, with property-based tests covering 200 invariants.
- Built the statement generation pipeline producing 2 million PDF statements a month within a 6-hour window.
- Owned the secrets rotation process for 45 services, completing every rotation without a production incident.
- Introduced blue-green deployments for the payments gateway, cutting release-related errors by 80%.

**Senior Software Engineer — Quillfeather Media** (2017–2019)
- Built the video metadata service in Go and PostgreSQL, serving 25 million catalogue lookups a day for the web and mobile apps.
- Designed the caching layer with Redis that cut origin load by 70% during live events.
- Owned the search indexing pipeline on Kafka and Elasticsearch, reindexing 8 million titles in under 2 hours.
- Led the adoption of structured logging and tracing across 20 services, shortening incident diagnosis from hours to minutes.
- Created the feature flag service used by 9 teams, with gradual rollout and automatic rollback on error budgets.
- Reduced cloud costs by 22% by consolidating 30 small services onto a shared runtime.
- Built the subtitle delivery service handling 30 languages and 1.5 million subtitle files.
- Designed the A/B testing backend that ran 120 experiments a year for the recommendations team.
- Owned the playback session API, sustaining 50,000 concurrent viewers during premieres.
- Wrote the PostgreSQL to Elasticsearch synchronisation worker with exactly-once delivery through Kafka offsets.

**Software Engineer — Ostrava Health** (2015–2017)
- Built the appointment scheduling API in Python and Django used by 150 clinics, handling 400,000 bookings a month.
- Designed the audit trail for patient record access under HIPAA, storing 2 years of events with tamper-evident hashing.
- Owned the HL7 integration with 6 laboratory systems, including retries, dead-letter handling and alerting.
- Wrote the data export service producing nightly files for 12 partner insurers.
- Improved API response times by 45% by replacing N+1 queries and adding PostgreSQL indexes.
- Ran the on-call rotation for the scheduling domain, authoring 15 runbooks.

**Software Engineer — Pinecrest Travel** (2013–2015)
- Built the fare search aggregator in Java, combining results from 9 airline APIs in under 2 seconds.
- Designed the booking state machine that reduced double bookings from 1.2% to 0.05%.
- Owned the payment retry logic for 3 payment providers, recovering 8% of failed transactions.
- Wrote the nightly pricing import processing 40 million fare records.
- Created the load testing suite simulating 10,000 concurrent searches before each peak season.
- Maintained the customer notification service sending 500,000 emails and texts a week.

**Software Engineer — Harrow Analytics** (2011–2013)
- Built ETL pipelines in Python and SQL loading 200 GB of retail sales data a day into the reporting warehouse.
- Designed the dimensional model for store performance used by 300 analysts.
- Owned the data quality checks that flagged 95% of upstream feed errors before reports ran.
- Wrote the scheduling framework that replaced 80 hand-run scripts.
- Created dashboards for 25 regional managers showing weekly sales against plan.
- Tuned the largest 50 warehouse queries, cutting report generation time by 60%.

**Junior Developer — Bellweather Retail** (2009–2011)
- Developed the store inventory web application in PHP and MySQL used by 120 stores.
- Built the barcode scanning integration for stock counts, cutting count time by 30%.
- Wrote the weekly replenishment report generating orders for 4,000 products.
- Maintained the point-of-sale synchronisation jobs across 3 time zones.
- Fixed over 200 defects in the legacy ordering system during its final 2 years.
- Automated the nightly database backups and restore tests.

**Junior Developer — Dunmore Telecom** (2007–2009)
- Developed billing report scripts in Perl and SQL for 1.5 million subscriber accounts.
- Built the internal tool for call detail record lookups used by 40 support agents.
- Wrote the monthly invoice batch job and its reconciliation checks.
- Maintained the SMS gateway integration handling 2 million messages a month.
- Migrated 60 shell scripts from a retired Solaris host to Linux.
- Documented the billing data model for the 12-person operations team.

## Skills
- Python, Go, Java, SQL
- PostgreSQL, Kafka, Redis, Elasticsearch, Airflow
- AWS, Docker, Kubernetes

## Education
**B.Sc. Software Engineering — Varrow Institute of Technology** (2007)
